description: project for the treatment of petroleum waste, recycling of used oils, destruction of all types of solid biodegradable and non-biodegradable waste
problem_statement: Environmental pollution due to excessive waste is very harmful to human health in Cameroon and in Africa. Global warming, desertification of the earth, water pollution, environmental pollution, deterioration of human health and deterioration of the health of animals and that of trees and plants are due to an excessive presence of very harmful waste dumped in nature, in waters, in seas, on roads, on land, along roadsides, which constitute a great danger for humanity and for the future of the world. to associate with this the problem of industrialization in Africa, the accelerated unemployment in Africa, the problem of misery, of poverty.
